title: Whangarei CDU-1 C-150: 8,500 to 13,000 t/d in the existing shell
source: Majumder, Mosca and Mahon, PTQ Q1 2013, NZRC/Shell/Sulzer operating case; article title omitted from the agent-facing citation because it names the later internals
question: Increase CDU-1 crude intake from 8,500 to 13,000 t/d in the existing C-150 shell while retaining the product cuts. Which section limits, and what physical change clears it?
data_note: Real NZRC revamp and performance test. The open paper publishes the process arrangement and section internals but not a complete crude assay; a DWSIM model therefore needs explicit petroleum pseudo-component assumptions. Later internals and the September 2010 test are withheld.
suggested_questions: Which C-150 section runs out of hydraulic capacity first?
Can a section-only change reach 13,000 t/d?
